Technical 
 Procedure

Equipment:Super charge air 
 circuit
 venkentiry italy
Introduction

This 
specfication defines the precaution and maintenance to be per for med during 
normal operation every 16000 operation hours to ensure good operation protection 
of all components

The first draft initiated by eng Ezat Mohamed Osma 
El bale, reviewed by eng Azmy Soliman, revised by quality control eng. Samir Abd 
ElGelil, and approved by end. Mohamed Abd El Ghafar.
General director of Al-Aresh PS.

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd el Gilil, 
EDEPC inspection & quality control general director, MPIS coordinator and 
certified by accountant Mohamed Soliman EDEPC ad minp final inspection and 
quality control's qeneral divorton and super visor of inspection & quality 
control's head sector
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued and the maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear the safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, shoes, gloves ...etc.
Isolate the circuit breaker of the pump motor
Disconnect electric terminal of the pump motor

The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and sactior 
 valves
Be sure pump must be completely drained
Be sure oil must be completely drainage

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out
Compressor and fig 9.B

Remove screw plug 46009 ad 
drain off the oil

Remove hex - headed screw 
32163 washers 39165 pat-locking nut 32164 and holding spring 32162

Screw tight fixing tool 
90030 to looking flange 32107 with hex headed screw 90031

Unlock cap nut 38001 and 
remove oil pump 36000 with C snaper 90240
Remove locking plate 32114

We screw ring nut 32151 
with box spanner 90050 remove fixing tool 90030

Pull out centrifing 32150 
(using extractor 90070 and extracting bash 90120 if necessary)

Remove hex - headed scre 
76021 and locking edge achers 76022

Screw on the extractor 
90070 to the inner bearing bush and withdraw bearing 32100

Do not remove guide bolt 
aoit defines the position of the bearing

If the bearing 32100 has 
to be replaced the pump holder 32161 should be unscrewed from the dismantled 
bearing ad be fixed to the new bearing with hex - headed screw 32152 and locking 
plate 32153 dismantled part have to be kept clean clean carefully the bearing 
champer before inserting the new bearing it is of utmost importance before 
fitting the bearing that the shoft end is 
 * Thoroughly cleaned
 * Coated with suitable coating to prevent sizning 
suchas as molyrote dx or 
 a similar praduct
